description: Returns full details for one route. Needs a slug from search_routes. If you do not have a slug, call search_routes first. Returns per-vehicle price tiers (indicative 'from' prices in local currency and approx. AED; the team confirms the final price), travel time and distance, border crossings and car-change steps, capacities, inclusions, FAQs and booking links. An unknown or invalid slug returns an error saying no route was found. Call create_inquiry when the customer wants to book.

slug.description: Exact route slug as returned by search_routes, e.g. 'dubai-to-muscat-private-transfer'.
